mapper.select: select id, username, display_name, mobile, email, password_salt, password_hash, status, super_admin, create_time, modify_time from cms_sys_user where username = #{username} limit 1

select id, username, display_name, mobile, email, password_salt, password_hash, status, super_admin, create_time, modify_time from cms_sys_user
and ( username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or display_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or mobile like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and status = #{status}
order by create_time desc, id desc
select r.role_code from cms_sys_role r inner join cms_sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 order by r.id asc

select distinct m.permission_code from cms_sys_menu m inner join cms_sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.id inner join cms_sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 1 and m.permission_code is not null and m.permission_code != '' order by m.permission_code asc
